oil.when: 2009 vans with the message center and SELECT/RESET stem on the instrument cluster
steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
With the ignition on, press and release the SELECT/RESET stem until the display shows OIL LIFE with the current percentage and HOLD RESET = NEW.
Press and hold the SELECT/RESET stem for about two seconds, then let go. The display shows OIL LIFE SET TO 100%.
Only if you want a shorter interval: while that message shows, press the stem again; each press lowers the starting value by 10%.
oil.note: A 100% starting value equals about 7,500 miles or six months. Checked in the 2009 E-150 owner's guide.
